The helpline representative provided an email address (csd@tes.com.pk) and requested that the issue details, along with the payment proof, be shared via email. We have accordingly sent the email and attached a screenshot of the sent email for reference.

44377500274.description:
The client has requested us to source an all-rounder with the following requirements and further details:

*
Further Details: Personal Care for Abbu * Routine Maintenance: Shave Abbu every week and handle "lower cleaning" (grooming) every three weeks. * Physical Assistance: Massage Abbu’s legs and take him for daily walks. * Medical Management: Responsible for all medicine administration and regular blood sugar checks. * General Caretaking: Provide total caretaking with a focus on patience and respect, treating him like a family elder. Household & Operational Tasks * Cleaning: Full responsibility for house cleaning, including dusting, mopping, and sweeping (jhadoo-tapri). * Kitchen Help: Assist Mama with meal prep, specifically cutting and preparing vegetables. * Chores: Washing dishes and ironing clothes. * Outdoor Errands: Handle market runs, grocery shopping, and arranging transportation (taxis or rickshaws) for family members. Schedule & Work Terms * Shift Hours: A 12-hour daily shift. * Start/End Time: The workday begins whenever Mama wakes up (typically 10:00 AM or 11:00 AM) and ends once Abbu and Mama are settled in bed for the night (around 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM). * Overtime: Any extra hours required beyond the standard shift will be tracked and compensated separately. * Time Off: One day off per week is standard, though a maximum of two days off every two weeks can be discussed with Mama. Candidate Profile & Attitude * Ego/Attitude: Must have "zero ego" and "zero tantrums"; any personal pride should be "left at the door". * Versatility: Must be willing to perform any task requested without saying "I can't do this" or making excuses. * Qualifications: No formal medical experience is required as long as they are diligent and caring. * Work Ethic: Expected to stay engaged and helpful throughout the day for the two-person household.
